name: resolution-capsule
description: Turn solved debugging sessions into sanitized, privacy-safe knowledge drafts ready for Stack Overflow, GitHub Discussions, or your team wiki.

resolutionCapsule.pythonPath.description: Python 3 executable used to run the local capsule engine. Change this if your Python is at a non-standard path (e.g. /usr/local/bin/python3).

enumDescriptions: Redacts secrets, tokens, emails, IPs, and internal URLs.
Balanced redactions plus ticket IDs and long numeric identifiers.
resolutionCapsule.sanitizationMode.description: Default sanitizer mode applied when generating a capsule.

resolutionCapsule.enginePath.description: Optional absolute path to capsule_cli.py. Leave empty to use the bundled engine.

resolutionCapsule.stackOverflow.clientId.description: OAuth client ID from your Stack Apps registration (stackapps.com/apps/oauth/register).

resolutionCapsule.stackOverflow.clientSe.description: OAuth client secret from your Stack Apps registration.

resolutionCapsule.stackOverflow.apiKey.description: Stack Exchange API key (optional, increases daily quota from 300 to 10 000 requests).
